# Hidden Spain Bargains — by La Comercial Inmobiliaria

> English-language property search and guides for people moving to Spain from the UK, US, Canada, Australia and New Zealand. Personal-shopper service: we select homes, research the area and negotiate the price; the buyer pays only if they buy.

## Area guide
- [Living in Villablino, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/villablino/): UNESCO Laciana Valley, services, schools, distances to airports.
- [Living in Palencia, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/palencia/): Palencia. Flats about €1,812/m² (October 2026). A calm, walkable cathedral city on the Carrión river, with high-speed trains to Madrid and prices far below the Spanish average.
- [Living in Venta de Baños, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/venta-de-banos/): Palencia. Flats about €1,022/m² (September 2026). A small town built around one of northern Spain's best-known railway junctions, ten minutes from Palencia and close to Valladolid.
- [Living in Zamora, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/zamora/): Zamora. Flats about €1,581/m² (October 2026). A golden-stone city on the Duero river, famous for its Romanesque churches and an hour's drive from the Portuguese border.
- [Living in Ponferrada, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/ponferrada/): León. Flats about €1,071/m² (October 2026). The Templar city of El Bierzo: a green valley of vineyards, Roman gold mines and the Camino de Santiago, with city services and very low prices.
- [Living in Astorga, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/astorga/): León. Flats about €1,096/m² (October 2026). A Roman town on two pilgrim routes, with a palace by Gaudí, a chocolate tradition and houses at some of the lowest prices in the region.
- [Living in Bembibre, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/bembibre/): León. Flats about €696/m² (September 2026). A friendly market town in El Bierzo where flats cost a quarter of the Spanish average, twenty minutes from Ponferrada.
- [Living in Aranda de Duero, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/aranda-de-duero/): Burgos. Flats about €1,702/m² (October 2026). The capital of the Ribera del Duero wine region, with miles of medieval cellars under its streets and the A-1 motorway to Madrid.
- [Living in Soria, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/soria/): Soria. Flats about €2,214/m² (October 2026). Spain's quietest provincial capital: Romanesque churches, the Duero river, pine forests and the poet Antonio Machado's streets.
- [Living in Ávila, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/avila/): Ávila. Flats about €1,752/m² (October 2026). A city inside complete medieval walls, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, within easy reach of Madrid by train.
- [Living in Medina del Campo, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/medina-del-campo/): Valladolid. Flats about €1,137/m² (October 2026). A royal market town with a great brick castle, one of Spain's largest main squares and trains to Madrid in under an hour, from about €1,100 per m².
- [Living in Medina de Rioseco, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/medina-de-rioseco/): Valladolid. Flats about €1,126/m² (October 2026). The 'city of the admirals' in the Tierra de Campos: a porticoed high street, grand churches and the end of the Canal de Castilla.
- [Living in Arévalo, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/arevalo/): Ávila. Flats about €1,052/m² (October 2026). A Mudéjar brick town between Ávila, Segovia and Valladolid, where Isabella of Castile grew up.
- [Living in Nava de la Asunción, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/nava-de-la-asuncion/): Segovia. Flats about €757/m² (October 2026). A village in Segovia's pine forests, close to the castle of Coca, where a house with a garden costs less than a city parking space elsewhere.
- [Living in Peñafiel, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/penafiel/): Valladolid. Flats about €1,047/m² (October 2026). The heart of Ribera del Duero wine country, under a castle shaped like a ship that houses the provincial wine museum.
- [Living in Laguna de Duero, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/laguna-de-duero/): Valladolid. Flats about €1,876/m² (October 2026). Not the lowest-priced town on our list, but one of the best for quality of life: pine woods, a lagoon and Valladolid ten minutes away.
- [Living in Ferrol, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/ferrol/): A Coruña. Flats about €1,318/m² (October 2026). A naval city on the Galician coast, with Modernist streets, wild Atlantic beaches and the start of the English Way to Santiago.
- [Living in Avilés, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/aviles/): Asturias. Flats about €1,766/m² (October 2026). A historic Asturian town with porticoed streets, the Niemeyer Centre on its estuary and beaches and an airport close by.
- [Living in Tarancón, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/tarancon/): Cuenca. Flats about €1,396/m² (October 2026). A La Mancha town on the A-3 motorway, about 80 km from Madrid, with a Roman city and a great monastery nearby.
- [Living in Perales de Tajuña, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/perales-de-tajuna/): Madrid. Flats about €1,922/m² (October 2026). A village in the green Tajuña valley, inside the Madrid region, with a greenway for walking and cycling and Madrid about 45 km away.
- [Living in Puertollano, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/puertollano/): Ciudad Real. Flats about €772/m² (October 2026). A town with a high-speed station on the Madrid–Seville line and some of the lowest flat prices of any town its size in Spain.
- [Living in Badajoz, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/badajoz/): Badajoz. Flats about €1,843/m² (October 2026). A sunny border city on the Guadiana river, with a great Moorish citadel and Portugal across the bridge.
- [Living in Mérida, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/merida/): Badajoz. Flats about €1,323/m² (October 2026). The capital of Extremadura, where you can live next to a Roman theatre that still stages plays every summer.
- [Living in Lepe, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/lepe/): Huelva. Flats about €2,132/m² (October 2026). The Costa de la Luz without the crowds: long Atlantic beaches at La Antilla, strawberry fields, and Portugal half an hour away.
- [Living in San Esteban de Gormaz, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/san-esteban-de-gormaz/): Soria. Flats about €1,162/m² (September 2026). A quiet town on the Duero with two of the oldest Romanesque porticoed churches in Spain, in the Soria part of Ribera del Duero.
- [Living in Pontevedra, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/pontevedra/): Pontevedra. Flats about €2,599/m² (October 2026). The small Galician city famous for giving its centre back to pedestrians, at the heart of the Rías Baixas and Albariño country.
- [Living in Ourense, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/ourense/): Ourense. Flats about €1,938/m² (October 2026). A Galician city of hot springs, where you can bathe in free thermal pools along the Miño river, with high-speed trains to Madrid.
- [Living in Lugo, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/lugo/): Lugo. Flats about €1,847/m² (October 2026). A city still fully ringed by its Roman walls, which you can walk all the way round, in green inland Galicia.
- [Living in Murcia, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/murcia/): Murcia. Flats about €1,789/m² (October 2026). A sunny, lively city with a baroque cathedral, orange and lemon orchards all around and the Mediterranean about 45 minutes away.
- [Living in Cartagena, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/cartagena/): Murcia. Flats about €1,842/m² (October 2026). A 3,000-year-old port city on the Mediterranean, with a Roman theatre in the old town and wild beaches nearby.
- [Living in Xàtiva, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/xativa/): Valencia. Flats about €1,389/m² (October 2026). The town of the Borgia popes, under a great hilltop castle, with commuter trains to Valencia.
- [Living in Ontinyent, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/ontinyent/): Valencia. Flats about €1,255/m² (October 2026). A textile town in the green Vall d'Albaida, with natural river pools and one of the biggest Moors and Christians festivals in the region.
- [Living in Elda, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/elda/): Alicante. Flats about €1,093/m² (October 2026). Spain's shoe-making capital in the Vinalopó valley, about 40 minutes from Alicante, its beaches and its airport.
- [Living in Almendralejo, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/almendralejo/): Badajoz. Flats about €912/m² (October 2026). The wine town of Extremadura, in the vineyards of Tierra de Barros, about 25 minutes from Roman Mérida.
- [Living in Huelva, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/huelva/): Huelva. Flats about €1,723/m² (October 2026). The Andalusian city where Columbus's story begins, between marshland nature reserves and long Atlantic beaches.
- [Living in Jerez de la Frontera, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/jerez-de-la-frontera/): Cádiz. Flats about €1,917/m² (October 2026). The city of sherry, horses and flamenco, with its own airport and the beaches of Cádiz half an hour away.
- [Living in Córdoba, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/cordoba/): Córdoba. Flats about €1,995/m² (October 2026). One of the world's great historic cities, home of the Mosque-Cathedral, with high-speed trains to Madrid and Seville.
- [Living in Peñarroya-Pueblonuevo, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/penarroya-pueblonuevo/): Córdoba. Flats about €644/m² (October 2026). A former mining town in the Guadiato valley, in the north of Córdoba province, with some of the lowest home prices in Andalusia.
- [Living in Jaén, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/jaen/): Jaén. Flats about €1,719/m² (October 2026). The capital of the world's largest olive oil region, under a hilltop castle, with a great Renaissance cathedral.
- [Living in Linares, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/linares/): Jaén. Flats about €928/m² (October 2026). A mining city in Jaén province, birthplace of the guitarist Andrés Segovia, with flats at about a third of the Spanish average.
- [Living in Úbeda, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/ubeda/): Jaén. Flats about €1,210/m² (October 2026). A Renaissance jewel among the olive groves of Jaén, a UNESCO World Heritage Site together with nearby Baeza.
- [Living in La Carolina, Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/areas/la-carolina/): Jaén. Flats about €623/m² (October 2026). A planned 18th-century town at the gateway to Andalusia, on the A-4 motorway near the Despeñaperros pass.

## Nature & lifestyle
- [Ponferrada: a Templar city for people who love history](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/guides/ponferrada-templar-city-of-history.html): A Templar castle, the Camino de Santiago, Roman gold mines and a wine valley: why Ponferrada, in north-west Spain, wins over visitors from far away.
- [From the edge of the world to the middle of Europe](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/guides/living-in-the-middle-of-europe.html): Long-haul flights for every holiday? Living in Spain puts Europe's cities, history and food a short trip away. Here's how connected north-west Spain is.
- [Christmas in the snow: the seasons, the other way round](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/guides/christmas-in-the-snow-seasons-reversed.html): A white Christmas, a ski slope 15 km away and fresh summers: the seasons in north-west Spain for people raised down under.
- [Trade Canadian winters for Spanish ones](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/guides/trade-canadian-winters-for-spanish-ones.html): You like real seasons but not five months of minus twenty. Spain's mountains give you snow, ski slopes and sun, with far shorter, softer winters.
- [Brown bears and birch forests: the wild Spain](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/guides/brown-bears-and-birch-forests.html): New Zealand has no large wild mammals. North-west Spain has brown bears and capercaillie. Where to see them, and where to live.
- [Las Médulas and El Bierzo: landscapes that rival home](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/guides/las-medulas-and-el-bierzo-landscapes.html): Red Roman gold mines, vineyards and mountain villages. Why El Bierzo, in north-west Spain, wins over people who grew up with New Zealand's landscapes.
- [Green Spain: for Britons who don't want the Costas](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/guides/green-spain-for-brits-who-dont-want-the-costas.html): Mountains, forests, four seasons and stone villages: the Spain most British buyers never see, and why the Laciana Valley could suit you.
- [Small-town Spain vs the American suburbs](https://hiddenspainbargains.netlify.app/guides/small-town-spain-vs-american-suburbs.html): Walk to the pharmacy, the bakery and the health centre. What daily life is like in a Spanish mountain town compared with a car-dependent suburb.
